question: Do inert query/no-op syscalls — futex(FUTEX_WAKE) with no waiters, gettimeofday, sched_getattr, and a sched_setaffinity self round-trip — reach L2 parity across the golden ptrace backend and the e9patch-rewritten ptrace path?

environment.note: Fleet PMU heavily contended (~365 concurrent --verify processes, loadavg ~790). These single-syscall probes have minimal RCBs and hit L2 on the first verify attempt for both golden and e9; vetting used killpg-on-wedge retry for the verify legs as a precaution.

result.golden_ptrace: 4/4 L2verified=1; native==golden and expected stdout matched
result.e9patch: 4/4 PASS_L2 exit=0 sites c/1 m/1 b0/0 prologue=8 tail_match=yes
